duty.en: Fills a video's title, description, playlists and tags from your upload sheet and saves, then reloads and reads back what is really saved, listing every difference.
duty.ko: 업로드 시트대로 제목, 설명, 재생목록, 태그를 채우고 저장한 뒤, 새로고침해서 실제로 저장된 것을 읽고 다른 점을 모두 적습니다.

steps: finish: fill title, description, playlists, tags and Save (experimental)
check: reload and read what is really saved
humanGates: finish only touches what your sheet lists; run check after it
